strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Look for price to make a liquidity grab: a fake breakout of support or resistance that then reverses direction. Enter on the candle that made the liquidity grab, with longs taken after a bullish grab and shorts after a bearish grab.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab, and take profit at a recent swing high for longs or recent swing low for shorts. The trade is managed as a reversal with a tight stop and a fixed nearby target.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all time frames; example shown on lower timeframe with higher-timeframe confluence.
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Enter at the candle that initiated the liquidity grab after price breaks support and reverses up.
variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent high; stop below the liquidity grab.
variants.transcript_quote: your long entry would be at this point right here because this candle made this liquidity grab

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all time frames; example shown on lower timeframe with higher-timeframe confluence.
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Enter at the candle that initiated the liquidity grab after price breaks resistance and reverses down.
variants.target_note: Take profit at a recent low; stop above the liquidity grab.
variants.transcript_quote: your short entry would be at the bottom of this candle that initiated this liquidity grab

strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal_with_divergence_confluence
strategies.entry_summary: Use the same liquidity-grab reversal entry, but only when the liquidity grab aligns with momentum divergence: for example, price makes lower lows while the oscillator makes higher highs for a bullish setup. The divergence is an added confirmation filter, not a different base entry trigger.
strategies.exit_summary: Use the same reversal management as the base liquidity-grab setup: stop just beyond the grab and take profit at the next recent swing extreme.

variants.variant_label: liquidity grab plus momentum divergence confluence
variants.timeframe_note: Demonstrated as an added filter on top of the base setup; no fixed timeframe change stated.
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Require divergence on the momentum oscillator in addition to the liquidity grab.
variants.target_note: Same recent-high/recent-low target as the base setup.
variants.transcript_quote: we combine both the powers of the Divergence and the bullish liquidity grab and it gives us a higher probability

strategies.name: higher_timeframe_support_resistance_filtered_liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Take the liquidity-grab reversal only when the setup occurs at a higher-timeframe support or resistance area. The trader confirms the lower-timeframe liquidity grab by checking that the signal sits at a meaningful higher-timeframe level, then enters the normal reversal trade.
strategies.exit_summary: Manage the trade exactly like the normal liquidity-grab reversal: stop beyond the grab and target the nearby swing extreme on the active trading timeframe.

variants.timeframe_note: Lower-timeframe signal checked against a higher timeframe; example uses 15-minute entries and 1-hour context.
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Require the signal to occur at higher-timeframe support or resistance before taking the lower-timeframe liquidity grab.
variants.target_note: Use the normal 15-minute stop loss and take profit at the recent high/low.
variants.transcript_quote: we then move to a 1hour time frame and we see this Buy Signal signal happened exactly at a support on a higher time frame

result.enumeration_note: One base liquidity-grab reversal is taught, plus two compatible confluence filters that preserve the same management skeleton: divergence and higher-timeframe support/resistance.
